title: Analysis code and derived aggregate results: persistence of threshold-defined hyperkalaemia in cardiac intensive care (MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD)
description: Analysis code and derived aggregate results for a study of how often an episode of incident hyperkalaemia defined by a single potassium threshold (>=5.5 mmol/L) persists in cardiac intensive care, whether reversion is explained by analytical error, and whether persistence carries prognostic information. The analysis is run independently in MIMIC-IV v3.1 and the eICU Collaborative Research Database v2.0. No patient-level data are included, because the source databases are distributed under credentialed data-use agreements that prohibit redistribution.
